title: Using NOTIFICATION_PROCESS doesn't automatically enable processing for a Node.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 23 May 2026 14:21:20 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-8100 CPU @ 3.60GHz (4 threads) - 7.57 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The engine should detect NOTIFICATION_PROCESS, and thus call set_process(true). This is really annoying because you have to put lots of: ```func _notification: pass``` in your code or call set_process(true) on ready.(probably NOTIFICATION_READY if you're working with notifications)

While this doesn't bother me that much now. (It's basically a reflex now everytime I see it not working),I can still forget it sometimes, and it does waste time.

This is worse for people who hasn't worked with this before. It can take a _long_ time before figuring out
exactly what went wrong.

I'm sorry if the issue already exists. I haven't been able to find it.

**When I refer to NOTIFICATION_PROCESS, set_process(), or process(), I'm also refering to their physics_process() counterparts.**

### Steps to reproduce

Run the project. See the output panel. Only the node with process() prints to the screen.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[notification_process_possible_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30722653/notification_process_possible_bug.zip)
